LaTeX source and verification code for the paper *Weak-Type Endpoint Bounds for Bochner–Riesz Means in Every Dimension* by Deep Bhattacharjee (54 pages).

At the critical index the Bochner–Riesz means in every dimension n ≥ 2 are of weak type (p,p) for 1 < p < 2n/(n+1), uniformly in the radius, and converge in weak L^p (Theorem A); they have sparse bounds sharp except at the corner of the Beltran–Roos–Seeger trapezoid (Theorem B), and weighted weak-type bounds for every A_1 weight with a range of p governed by its reverse Hölder exponent (Theorem C). The proof reproduces, with credit and complete proofs, OpenAI's preprint *Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation* (25 October 2026) and the ε-removal of Beltran, Roos and Seeger.

Attached: the compiled paper, the TeX sources as a zip, and an arXiv tarball. The check program (22 checks) and the Lean 4 file (18 theorems, standard axioms only) are in the repository.
